verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible inference provider, so a programmatic model-listing endpoint is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only documents a human-readable 'Choose a model' docs page and lists supported APIs (Chat Completions, Responses, speech to text, Anthropic Messages) without any GET /v1/models endpoint. An OpenAPI spec exists, but nothing shows it includes a model-listing route.
